brief: Independent interpretation of the same architecture
prompt: Create original technical concept art of SpaceDonkey. Compose independently from this architecture; do not imitate prior images or infographics. Earth has one continuous self-supporting structural ring exactly around the equator, centered on Earth and co-rotating with it. No internal rotor, GEO counterweight, elevator cable, or single giant skyhook. Many unequal powered swings hang inward from the ring. One payload travels eastward and repeatedly enters near-tangent, low-relative-velocity merge corridors with successive swings: electromagnetic guidance aligns it, a mechanical lock carries the load, the swing accelerates it through a finite arc, then timed release sends it into free flight toward another swing. Free legs may rise, coast, glide, or descend; no literal jumping. Repeated transfers add eastward momentum until the final free-flight path becomes orbit. Serious early-2000s transhumanist proposal art; schematic, image-heavy, no visible text, logos, or watermarks.
